Lauren / Ben —

Forwarding Claire's request. BrightWave is asking for 25% off hosted usage for the pilot. Revenue for the PoC itself is modest (~$28k list revenue over 6 weeks), but they are strategic: enterprise prospect in our target healthcare vertical with potential expansion to Dedicated in H2. Procurement is insistent that we match 25% to push internal approval.

Can deal desk confirm whether 25% requires exec sign-off, and if so, who should we route to? We can offer conditional terms: 12-month follow-on commit or full SOC2 data access as tradeoffs.

Quick context bullets:
- Proposed PoC value: $28k list hosted usage, 6-week term
- Proposed concession: 25% one-time off hosted usage during pilot
- Upside: reference customer, enterprise expansion, case study + marketplace listing

Thanks,
Aditya

Aditya —

25% on hosted pricing is outside standard delegated authority for deal desk (our limit is 20% for strategic pilots with commercial approval). This will need an executive concession. Please prepare the following and I'll route it up:

Required for exec packet:
- Finalized SOW + pilot scope (attach)
- L360 revenue impact calc (see template) and net margin at 25%
- Proposed contractual guardrails (12-month follow-on commitment OR marketplace/case study clause)
- Any security/compliance asks that materially increase cost

I attached a quick pricing template — fill numbers and send back. If this looks strategic, loop Marissa and Rishi for expedited approval.

Lauren Bishop

Subject: Re: BrightWave request — exec signoff needed for 25% concession

Team —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the SOW and the margin calc. BrightWave is a high-priority healthcare lead with potential Dedicated conversion in Q3. I support an exec concession here but only on clear conditions. My recommendation to Rishi: grant up to 25% off hosted usage for the pilot if BrightWave signs a 12-month minimum committed usage plan at list rates starting month 2 (we cascade pilot tokens to committed bucket), plus a one-paragraph customer reference and permission to publish a short case study.

If Rishi approves, legal can exercise a DocuSign addendum template that encodes the conditional commitment.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval: conditional 25% hosted concession for BrightWave PoC

Team —

I reviewed the deal packet and Marissa's recommendation. Executive decision: APPROVED. Conditions to include in the addendum and SOW:

- 25% discount applied to hosted API usage during the 6-week pilot only.
- Customer must sign a 12-month committed usage agreement at list rates within 30 days of pilot conclusion; unpaid pilot credits do not convert without signature.
- Case study permission (one-paragraph) and inclusion in our healthcare reference list required in exchange for concession.
- Legal to add a clawback clause: if customer does not execute the 12-month commitment within 30 days, the discount will be invoiced retroactively.

Lauren: please prepare the DocuSign addendum and confirm the margin calc. Aditya: let Claire/procurement know and route DocuSign once ready.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
